text:
Ben_sales: FYI — ACME SMB reached out asking for a custom packaging option. They want reserved capacity + monthly credits, plus a blended per-token rate and a 99.9% SLA. Can product weigh in?
Amy_prod: thanks — can you paste their expected monthly token volumes and any hard dates?
Ben_sales: They projected ~120M tokens/mo for Q2 (growing to 300M in 6mo). Pilot starts in ~3 weeks. They want pricing for pilot -> production.
Devon_support: note: ACME hit throttling issues in last demo when bursts spiked. We should avoid hard cutoffs for pilot. :warning:
Carla_fin: approx margin constraints? Finance needs a floor. We also need to know whether credits are refundable or applied to overages.
Ben_sales: They prefer credits applied to overages first, then committed usage. No refunds.
Ed_eng: Operational constraints: to offer 99.9% SLA with reserved pool for that volume we need to allocate a warm pool and cross-region fallback. That means standby GPUs and faster autoscale; billable cost will be higher.
Amy_prod: high-level options to consider (quick sketch):
```
1) Reserved capacity + monthly credit bucket (10% discount), soft overage at baseline per-token rate, SLA with warm pool during business hours only.
2) Blended committed rate (flat $X / 1M tokens) including a small credit cushion, full 99.9% SLA, requires min commit of $Y/mo and 30-day canary.
3) Pay-as-you-go + burst credits (no SLA), cheaper unit price but no availability guarantees.
```
Amy_prod: We need product + finance to pick a recommended path and guardrails to present to ACME by end of week. Pilot scope determines engineering effort.
Carla_fin: finance can support option 2 if commit >= $60k/mo (ARR math checked). We can do up to 15% discount at that threshold, subject to revenue recognition and legal T&Cs.
Rebecca_csm: pilot success criteria from CSM side: P95 latency <200ms, error rate <0.5%, and predictable monthly cost not exceeding their budget cap. They also want data isolation guarantees.
Ed_eng: engineering asks for chosen model size and quantization expectation. If they want the lowest latency we should pin to an L2 variant and enable KV cache. That increases cost. Also need at least 10 business days to provision dedicated warm pool + smoke tests.
Ben_sales: ACME is willing to sign a short LOI for pilot commit (two-week pilot with opt-in production). I'll confirm exact commit threshold.
Amy_prod: product proposal to present: recommend option 2 (blended committed rate + 99.9% SLA) but with conditional terms: commit >= $50k/mo, 2-week canary with autoscale cap, and legal-approved rollback clause. Ask finance for final floor and legal for rollback language.
Carla_fin: we can lower floor to $50k/mo if sales takes the discount hit structure: 10% for first 3 months then re-evaluate. I'll draft a term sheet.
billing-bot: Estimated billing impact (rough): committed pool + warm standby -> incremental cost ~ $18k/mo; blended unit price recommendation: $0.9 / 1M tokens (placeholder).
Amy_prod: thanks — engineering lead @Ed_eng, can you confirm provisioning timeline if we lock pilot next Tuesday?
Ed_eng: rough yes: 10 business days for pool + 3 days for canary instrumentation. We can accelerate but need overtime budget.
Amy_prod: ok — action items: 1) Ben_sales confirm LOI and exact commit by EOD tomorrow, 2) Carla_fin draft term sheet with 10% introductory discount and rollback clause, 3) Ed_eng confirm accelerated cost and any infra pre-buys, 4) Rebecca_csm prepare pilot success checklist. I'll consolidate and send to ACME. :white_check_mark:
Ben_sales: will do. Thanks all.
Devon_support: add runbook for overage/backfill during pilot pls.
Carla_fin: looping legal next.
Rebecca_csm: I'll prep dashboards and SLO tracking.
Amy_prod: filing this as our recommended ask. If anyone has objections to option 2, speak now, otherwise I'll present to ACME tomorrow.
Ben_sales: no objections from sales side.
Carla_fin: fine from finance, pending legal.
Ed_eng: fine, engineering notes applied.
Amy_prod: great — closing thread. :rocket:
